meta.title: Session Status HUD
meta.description: A floating panel at the top-right that counts running, waiting and finished sessions, and clears each completion alert once you open that session.
meta.detail:
# Session Status HUD

A small, always-available readout of what the harness is doing: how many sessions are **running**, how many **wait for you**, and how many have **finished**.

## What you get

- A pill in the top-right corner: `1 running · 2 waiting` plus a green `3 completed` badge when finished sessions are waiting to be read.
- Click it (or let a completion open it) to see one row per session, with a 4-character session tag so sessions in the same workspace stay distinguishable.
- **Open a session and its alert is gone.** The panel clears that row the moment the session becomes the visible one — no "mark all read" step.
- **Finished work in a background session is what alerts.** A session you are already looking at never pops a notification for you.
- The pill is draggable; its position is remembered. Click outside or press `Escape` to collapse it.
- `Completed turns` accumulates across harness restarts.

## Requirements

DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.5` with the Web UI and the `webServer` service. No configuration is required.
